zeroSecretPolicy.rule: RULE 1: Never output, print, or commit API keys, bearer tokens, or private secrets.
zeroSecretPolicy.enforcement: Automated regex and entropy-based redactor applied on all registry files, event streams, and logs.

TIER_0_IN_PROCESS.name: Native Specialist Memory
TIER_0_IN_PROCESS.description: Pure in-process model execution; no direct filesystem mutation; zero network privilege.

TIER_1_PROCESS_JOB_OBJECT.name: Managed OS Process Sandbox
TIER_1_PROCESS_JOB_OBJECT.description: Windows Job Objects / Linux cgroups v2; hard memory cap (512MB); timeout (300s); workspace-scoped writes.

TIER_2_OCI_MICRO_VM.name: Container Sandbox Enclave
TIER_2_OCI_MICRO_VM.description: Ephemeral rootless OCI container; no /var/run/docker.sock mounting; dropped capabilities; restricted network egress.

TIER_3_QUARANTINE_ENCLAVE.name: Physical Quarantine Sandbox
TIER_3_QUARANTINE_ENCLAVE.description: Air-gapped filesystem location; execution blocked at OS ACL and tool dispatcher level.

antiRecursionInvariant.rootCoordinatorExclusivity: orchestration-agent-v4 is the single root coordinator; subagents may never become root
